card.text: M9 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 8,300 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 9 or M9 is a globular cluster in the constellation of Ophiuchus.

introduction.text: M9 is drawn as 442 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.

sources.quote: It is positioned in the southern part of the constellation to the southwest of Eta Ophiuchi, and lies atop a dark cloud of dust designated Barnard 64.
